act_title: The Infant Milk Substitutes, Feeding Bottles and Infant Foods (Regulation of Production, Supply and Distribution) Act, 1992
title: Application of Act 37 of 1954 not barred
text:
25. Application of Act 37 of 1954 not barred.—The provisions of this Act, or the rules made

thereunder shall be in addition to, and not in derogation of, [the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006], or
the rules made thereunder.
